title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 32
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 32: the field bought at Anathoth, the deed given to Baruch, and the promise that fields will be bought again.

questions.text: Where was Jeremiah the prophet shut up while the king of Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 32:2 says Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the guard, which was in the king of Judah's house.

answers.text: In the court of the guard, in the king of Judah's house
In the house of Jonathan the scribe, in Jerusalem
In a room of Yahweh's house, above the new gate
In the dungeon of Malchijah the king's son

questions.text: Who came to Jeremiah and asked him to buy a field in Anathoth?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's word said that Hanamel the son of Shallum, Jeremiah's uncle, would come to him about the field in Anathoth, and Hanamel came and asked him to buy it.

answers.text: Baruch the son of Neriah
Hanamel the son of Shallum, his uncle
Mahseiah, the father of Neriah
Shallum the son of Hanamel, his brother

questions.text: How much silver did Jeremiah weigh out for the field?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah bought the field of Hanamel his uncle's son and weighed him the money, seventeen shekels of silver.

answers.text: Seven shekels of silver
Thirty shekels of silver
Seventeen shekels of silver
Seventy shekels of silver

questions.text: To whom did Jeremiah deliver the deed of the purchase?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, in the presence of Hanamel and of the witnesses.

answers.text: To Hanamel his uncle's son
To Zedekiah king of Judah
To the priests of Yahweh's house
To Baruch the son of Neriah

questions.text: Where was Baruch told to put the deeds, so that they would last many days?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah commanded that the sealed deed and the open deed be put in an earthen vessel, that they may last many days.

answers.text: Under the threshold of the king's house
In an earthen vessel
In the ark of the covenant
In a cave in the land of Benjamin

questions.text: What did Yahweh of Armies say would yet again be bought in this land?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, said that houses and fields and vineyards would yet again be bought in this land.

answers.text: Houses and fields and vineyards
Gold and silver and fine linen
Sheep and oxen and camels
Wine and oil and summer fruits

questions.text: In his prayer, what did Jeremiah say about God, who made the heavens and the earth?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah prayed that God had made the heavens and the earth by his great power and outstretched arm, and that there is nothing too hard for him.

answers.text: That he dwells only in Jerusalem
That he has forgotten his covenant
That he repents of all his words
That there is nothing too hard for him

questions.text: What did Jeremiah say had come to the city to take it?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said that siege ramps had come to the city to take it, and that the city was given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

answers.text: The chariots of Egypt
A plague of locusts
Siege ramps
The kings of the Medes

questions.text: Where had the people built the high places of Baal?
questions.explanation: They built the high places of Baal in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through fire to Molech.

answers.text: In the valley of the son of Hinnom
On the Mount of Olives
In the plains of Jericho
By the great waters of Gibeon

questions.text: What did Yahweh promise to give the people he would gather back to this place?
questions.explanation: Yahweh promised to give them one heart and one way, that they may fear him forever, for their good and the good of their children after them.

answers.text: A new king from Egypt
One heart and one way
Seven years of plenty
A wall of iron around the city
